action_instruction: Checking the displayed confirmation order number
intent: whether the displayed confirmation order number begins with 112-

action_params.condition: An "Order number" starting with "112-" is displayed.
action_params.query: whether the displayed confirmation order number begins with 112-

intent: the order total amount in the confirmation summary

action_params.query: the order total amount in the confirmation summary

action_instruction: Comparing the confirmation total with the product price
intent: whether the confirmation order total matches the displayed product price

action_params.query: whether the confirmation order total matches the displayed product price
action_params.code_js: (() => { const total = el(8).querySelector('[data-testid="confirm-total"] .ee-kv__v')?.textContent.trim(); const price = el(8).querySelector('[data-testid="cart-line-price"]')?.textContent.trim(); return total != null && price != null && total === price; })()

action_instruction: Reading the order total from the confirmation
intent: The "Order total" on the confirmation is saved as {{confirmation_order_total}}.

action_params.condition: The "Order total" on the confirmation is saved as {{confirmation_order_total}}.
action_params.query: The "Order total" on the confirmation is saved as {{confirmation_order_total}}.

intent: The product page price is saved as {{product_page_price}}.

action_params.condition: The product page price is saved as {{product_page_price}}.
action_params.query: The product page price is saved as {{product_page_price}}.

assertion_tree.description: An "Order number" starting with "112-" is displayed and {{confirmation_order_total}} reads "$129.00", matching {{product_page_price}}.

sub_results.description: An "Order number" starting with "112-" is displayed.

assertion_tree.verification: The confirmation displays an "Order number" starting with "112-", and {{confirmation_order_total}} reads "$129.00" and matches {{product_page_price}}.
